# Coolinarka

> Recipes from Instagram, Facebook, the web and video in one place. Cook mode, shopping list and online shopping in the store's own language. For iPhone and iPad, free.

Recipe app for iPhone, iPad (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6825835413). Free, with an optional one-time Plus purchase. No account and no ads. Recipes stay on the device and in the user's private iCloud. 14 languages: Slovensky, English, Čeština, Deutsch, Italiano, Polski, Magyar, Español, Français, Português, Українська, हिन्दी, 한국어, 简体中文.

## Features
- Saved with one tap: In Instagram, Facebook or Safari, tap Share and choose Coolinarka.
- Recipe from video: A video or screen recording becomes a recipe, with speech transcribed right on your phone.
- Weekly meal plan: Plan the whole week, fill empty slots from your favorites and send it all to your shopping list.
- Sorted: Meal types, tags, favorites and your own collections.
- Quick search: By name, ingredients or method, regardless of accents.
- Widget and Siri: The What to cook today widget on your Home and Lock Screen, and Siri: "What should I cook in Coolinarka".
- Send a recipe as a file: The recipient opens it in Coolinarka with its photo. Your ratings and notes stay out of it.
- The cover photo you want: Crop, rotate and filters.
- iPhone and iPad: Recipes sync through iCloud across devices with the same Apple account.
- Import and export: Back up your collection or move it to another app.
- 14 languages: Including the sample recipes and calorie estimates.
